name: dealstack-crm
description: Customers, quotations, proposals, GST invoices, payments, WhatsApp follow-ups, sales dashboard in one platform

scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push -w server && npm run db:seed -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev:worker -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
